name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol
description: Generator-time type shim for @deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol: the Typert generator only recognizes @Remote/TypertRemoteService when their declarations live inside a registered workspace package, so tsconfig.host.json's paths map the protocol import onto this stub for generation runs. Runtime and the normal build resolve the real npm package via node_modules.
